miehex.entry.enchant.desc1: I discovered that item enchantments can actually be abstracted to form Iotas. Using these Iotas, I can easily and conveniently use hexcraft to enchant items
miehex.advice.get_enchant.desc: Accepts an item entity and returns a list of iotas corresponding to all enchantments on it
miehex.advice.give_enchant.desc: Accepts an enchantment iota and an item entity, enchants that item, consuming media of amethyst dust with the cube of the enchantment level plus one amethyst shard
miehex.advice.enchant_add.desc: Accepts two enchantment iotas of the same type, adds their levels together, and returns a new high-level enchantment
